model: Uterine arterial network after Clark et al. 2018 (Placenta 66:74-81); appended after placental_o2_hill1972.json
order: Entries continue the index order of model/core.c after H_DMC; do not reorder.

parameters.name: CK_MODE
parameters.meaning: uterine arteries: 0 Jongen 2016 (single R_uta), 1 Clark 2018 network

parameters.name: CK_RUP
parameters.meaning: uterine + arcuate + radial arteries in series, both sides
parameters.source_detail: baseline geometry, 81 mu L/(8 pi r^4)/n; x 7.5006 (unit) / 2 (sides)

parameters.name: CK_RSA
parameters.meaning: spiral arteries, from the network node to the intervillous space
parameters.source_detail: placeholder; simulate.clark_parameters sets it so that the resting intervillous inflow and pressure are Jongen's
parameters.note: replaces Clark's lumped spiral artery + intervillous load R_L = 1.6 Pa s/mm3

parameters.name: CK_RA
parameters.meaning: arterio-venous anastomoses and their veins (bypass), both sides
parameters.source_detail: anastomoses 50 x (r 0.2 mm, L 9 mm) + venous resistance = R_up / 2

parameters.name: CK_KA
parameters.meaning: share of uterine pressure that acts as outflow pressure of the bypass
parameters.source_detail: Starling resistor against max(p_v,m, k_A p_ut); 0 = not compressed. Calibrated on the three Part A contraction scenarios of Jongen 2016 (grid step 0.05)
